prompts.text: Translate 'it works on my machine' into business speak.
Translate 'we need to refactor this' into something a PM won't question.
Translate 'that's a quick fix' into an honest sentence.
Translate 'the build is failing' into a calm status update.
Translate 'I'll get to your review after lunch' into developer truth.
Translate 'it's a known issue' for a client call.
Translate 'can you just add a field?' into what it actually costs.
Translate 'the tests pass' into the full story.
Translate 'we can make it work' into a realistic timeline.
Translate 'it's not a bug, it's a feature' for the changelog.
Translate 'let's just ship it' into a proper risk statement.
Translate 'I'm almost done' into a standup-friendly update.
